theme_central: Refining the divorce laws already laid down in Al-Baqarah and An-Nisa — precise method, waiting period, maintenance — interwoven with exhortations to piety: whoever fears Allah, He grants him a way out.
sources_note: 2-section structure precisely sourced (alim.org): divorce laws, then fate of the disbelievers and reward of the believers.

branches.title: Method of divorce
branches.resume: Divorcing during the period of purity, counting the 'idda; whoever fears Allah, He grants him a way out.

children.t: Method of divorce, waiting period; whoever fears Allah finds a way out

branches.title: Special cases, maintenance
branches.resume: Waiting period for menopausal or pregnant women; obligation to house and maintain during the 'idda.

children.t: Waiting period for menopausal, non-menstruating, or pregnant women
Obligation to house and maintain the woman during the 'idda, according to one's means

branches.title: Fate of the rebellious cities
branches.resume: Cities that refused the command of their Lord; a Reminder and a Messenger sent to guide toward the light.

children.t: Fate of the rebellious cities, Messenger sent to guide toward the light

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Seven heavens and seven earths, Allah's knowledge encompasses everything.

children.t: Seven heavens and seven earths, Allah's knowledge encompassing everything
